# Desktop contracts 0.1.0-dev.0

- Add desktop library values, typed queries, editing baselines, atomic graph inputs, relationships, records and local-content contracts.
- Define metadata participation and adoption, scanning, tasks, sessions, resources, views, preferences, application and extension management, and typed fact events.
- Provide strict native and extension deeplink round trips, versioned development control values, and English ICU type generation and translation validation.
- Implement pinned Unicode 18 normalization and natural ordering, with independent Node and browser tarball consumers.
